repository.name: @webex/storage-adapter-session-storage
repository.purpose: Published webex-core storage adapter backed by the browser sessionStorage API. new StorageAdapterSessionStorage(basekey) keeps every namespace of one instance in a single JSON document under that sessionStorage key. bind(namespace, options) checks the namespace and logger and resolves a binding whose get, put, and del read and rewrite the document and whose clear removes the whole basekey entry for every namespace. Absent keys reject with the webex-core NotFoundError, and each call logs one info line through the bound logger. No workspace package configures it; an application places an instance in a webex-core storage adapter slot.

public_interfaces.name: @webex/storage-adapter-session-storage package entry
public_interfaces.audience: applications that configure a webex-core storage adapter slot
public_interfaces.notes: Default export only; importing has no side effects. No workspace package configures this adapter. package.json main is dist/index.js and devMain is src/index.js.

public_interfaces.name: adapter and binding methods
public_interfaces.notes: bind rejects on a falsy namespace or missing options.logger and throws synchronously when the logger has no info method. get rejects NotFoundError for an absent key and resolves falsey values. put stores JSON-serializable values only. clear removes the whole basekey entry for every namespace, ignores any argument, and throws synchronously when sessionStorage is absent. Object.prototype names as keys or namespaces misbehave, and namespace __proto__ pollutes a built-in prototype.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not test stored values for truthiness.
negative_guidance.why: 0, false, null, and empty string are legitimate stored values (INV-002).

negative_guidance.rule: Do not scope clear to one namespace or give it a key parameter without a change request.
negative_guidance.why: Host logout relies on one clear call removing every namespace under the basekey (MOD-010, MOD-011).

negative_guidance.rule: Do not change the stored document layout or encoding without handling documents already stored.
negative_guidance.why: The document has no version field, and _load returns an empty object for anything it cannot find, so a layout change would silently drop data.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not use Object.prototype property names as keys or namespaces.
negative_guidance.why: Lookups have no own-property test, and namespace __proto__ pollutes a built-in prototype (MOD-016).

negative_guidance.rule: Do not log stored values through the bound logger.
negative_guidance.why: Hosts persist credentials and device state through storage adapters; only key names are logged today.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not treat README.md as the behavior reference.
negative_guidance.why: It calls the package a localStorage adapter; see docs/adr/0001-retain-product-readme.md.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not read a zero exit from test:unit or test:browser as passing behavior.
negative_guidance.why: test:unit skips all 21 cases and test:browser completes 0 tests.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not infer a coverage threshold for this package.
negative_guidance.why: No coverage script or threshold exists.
